purpose: Frozen probe set for AGENTS.md reference-material extraction A/B validation (issue #56).

probes.prompt: A PDF arrives in Telegram and later needs to be handed to a Hugin task. Which part of Ratatoskr validates it, and where are the original bytes kept so the downstream task can read them?
I want Ratatoskr to stop accepting uploaded documents entirely. Which setting turns that off, and what does it change?
Which settings point text triage at the M5 gateway, pin the local model, and cap how long Ratatoskr waits before giving up on that path?
How do I make my laptop send a Telegram ping through Ratatoskr without SSHing into the Pi?
What happens if a reminder becomes due and Ratatoskr crashes right after it marks the reminder as sending?
Do we have a recorded production proof that Ratatoskr can fire an alert into Heimdall and then resolve it cleanly?
If the M5 text-triage path errors or times out, what must Ratatoskr do with the incoming message?
